source: College Board SAT Suite / Khan Academy Digital SAT Math

skills.label: Linear equations in one variable
skills.description: Solve linear equations with one variable, including equations with variables on both sides, fractions, and parentheses

skills.label: Linear equation word problems
skills.description: Translate real-world situations into linear equations and solve; interpret the solution in context

skills.label: Linear equations in two variables
skills.description: Write, interpret, and solve linear equations in two variables; slope, intercepts, standard form, slope-intercept form, point-slope form

skills.label: Graphs of linear equations and functions
skills.description: Interpret and create graphs of linear equations; identify slope, x-intercept, y-intercept from a graph; match graphs to equations

skills.label: Linear functions
skills.description: Define and evaluate linear functions; understand rate of change and initial value; model linear relationships

skills.label: Linear function word problems
skills.description: Create and interpret linear functions from context; determine what the slope and intercept represent in the real world

skills.label: Systems of two linear equations
skills.description: Solve systems of two linear equations by substitution, elimination, or graphing; interpret number of solutions (one, none, infinite)

skills.label: Systems of linear equations — word problems
skills.description: Model real-world problems with systems of two linear equations and solve; interpret solutions in context

skills.label: Linear inequalities in one variable
skills.description: Solve and graph linear inequalities in one variable; interpret solution sets

skills.label: Linear inequalities in two variables
skills.description: Graph linear inequalities in two variables; determine which region satisfies the inequality; write inequalities from graphs

skills.label: Systems of linear inequalities
skills.description: Graph and interpret systems of linear inequalities; identify feasible regions; model constraints with inequality systems

skills.label: Equivalent expressions
skills.description: Rewrite algebraic expressions in equivalent forms; factor, expand, simplify; recognize structure in expressions

skills.label: Operations with polynomials
skills.description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide polynomials; understand polynomial long division and synthetic division

skills.label: Factoring quadratic and polynomial expressions
skills.description: Factor quadratics (GCF, difference of squares, trinomial factoring); factor higher-degree polynomials; use factoring to solve equations

skills.label: Solving quadratic equations
skills.description: Solve quadratic equations by factoring, completing the square, and the quadratic formula; determine number and nature of solutions

skills.label: Quadratic functions and graphs
skills.description: Interpret vertex, axis of symmetry, intercepts, and direction of parabolas; convert between standard, vertex, and factored forms

skills.label: Exponential functions
skills.description: Understand exponential growth and decay; percent change; interpret parameters in exponential models; compare linear vs. exponential growth

skills.label: Polynomial functions
skills.description: End behavior based on degree and leading coefficient; zeros and multiplicity; graph behavior; factor theorem

skills.label: Radicals and rational exponents
skills.description: Simplify expressions with radicals and rational exponents; convert between radical and exponential notation; solve equations with radicals

skills.label: Rational expressions and equations
skills.description: Simplify, add, subtract, multiply, and divide rational expressions; solve rational equations; identify extraneous solutions

skills.label: Radical, rational, and absolute value equations
skills.description: Solve equations involving radicals, rational expressions, and absolute value; check for and eliminate extraneous solutions

skills.label: Systems of one linear and one nonlinear equation
skills.description: Solve systems where one equation is linear and one is quadratic or other nonlinear; interpret number of intersection points

skills.label: Function notation, composition, and transformations
skills.description: Evaluate and interpret function notation; compose functions; understand transformations (shifts, reflections, stretches)

skills.label: Ratios and rates
skills.description: Set up and solve ratio problems; understand rates and unit rates; work with part-to-part and part-to-whole ratios

skills.label: Proportional relationships
skills.description: Identify and use proportional relationships; solve proportions; understand direct and inverse proportionality

skills.label: Units and unit conversion
skills.description: Convert between units using dimensional analysis; work with derived units; interpret units in context

skills.label: Percentages
skills.description: Calculate percent of a quantity; percent increase and decrease; percent change; working backwards from a percentage

skills.label: Measures of center
skills.description: Calculate and interpret mean, median, and mode; effect of adding/removing data on measures of center

skills.label: Measures of spread
skills.description: Calculate and interpret range, interquartile range, and standard deviation; understand variability; compare distributions

skills.label: Data distributions
skills.description: Interpret histograms, dot plots, box plots, and frequency tables; describe shape (symmetric, skewed); identify outliers

skills.label: Scatterplots and lines of best fit
skills.description: Interpret scatterplots; draw and use lines of best fit; understand positive/negative/no correlation; predict values

skills.label: Two-variable data models
skills.description: Determine whether a linear, quadratic, or exponential model best fits data; interpret the model in context

skills.label: Probability
skills.description: Calculate theoretical and experimental probability; use sample spaces; understand complementary and mutually exclusive events

skills.label: Conditional probability and two-way tables
skills.description: Calculate conditional probabilities from two-way tables; P(A|B) notation; independence; relative frequency

skills.label: Inference from sample statistics
skills.description: Understand margin of error; make inferences about populations from samples; interpret confidence intervals

skills.label: Evaluating statistical claims
skills.description: Distinguish observational studies from experiments; understand confounding variables, bias, and causation vs. correlation

skills.label: Area of 2D figures
skills.description: Calculate area of triangles, quadrilaterals (rectangles, parallelograms, trapezoids), and composite figures

skills.label: Perimeter and circumference
skills.description: Calculate perimeter of polygons and circumference of circles; work with arcs

skills.label: Volume and surface area
skills.description: Calculate volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres; composite 3D figures

skills.label: Lines and angles
skills.description: Supplementary, complementary, vertical angles; angles formed by parallel lines cut by a transversal (corresponding, alternate interior, co-interior)

skills.label: Triangle properties
skills.description: Triangle angle sum; exterior angles; isosceles and equilateral triangles; triangle inequality

skills.label: Similar and congruent triangles
skills.description: Similarity criteria (AA, SAS, SSS); congruence criteria; use proportions to find missing sides in similar figures

skills.label: Special right triangles
skills.description: 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangle side ratios; apply to find missing lengths without trigonometry

skills.label: Pythagorean theorem
skills.description: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find missing sides; Pythagorean triples; distance in the coordinate plane

skills.label: Right triangle trigonometry
skills.description: SOH-CAH-TOA; find missing sides and angles using sine, cosine, tangent; apply to word problems (angles of elevation/depression)

skills.label: Unit circle and radian measure
skills.description: Convert between degrees and radians; find sine and cosine values using the unit circle; understand periodicity

skills.label: Circle properties — arcs and angles
skills.description: Central angles and inscribed angles; arc length; sector area; arc and chord relationships

skills.label: Equation of a circle
skills.description: Write and interpret the standard equation of a circle (x-h)²+(y-k)²=r²; complete the square to find center and radius

skills.label: Coordinate geometry
skills.description: Midpoint and distance formulas; slopes of parallel and perpendicular lines; geometric figures on the coordinate plane

skills.label: Central ideas and details
skills.description: Identify the main idea of a passage; distinguish central ideas from supporting details

skills.label: Command of evidence — textual
skills.description: Identify which quote or detail best supports a claim; evaluate evidence quality and relevance

skills.label: Command of evidence — quantitative
skills.description: Interpret data from graphs, tables, or charts alongside a passage; select evidence from quantitative sources

skills.label: Inferences
skills.description: Draw logical inferences from the passage; understand what the text implies but does not state directly

skills.label: Words in context
skills.description: Determine the meaning of a word or phrase as used in context; choose the most precise word for a given context

skills.label: Text structure and purpose
skills.description: Identify how a text is organized; understand the author's purpose; analyze how a specific sentence or paragraph functions

skills.label: Cross-text connections
skills.description: Compare two passages; identify agreements, disagreements, or relationships between authors' ideas

skills.label: Rhetorically effective synthesis
skills.description: Select information from notes or multiple sources to best accomplish a rhetorical goal; complete a sentence to support an argument

skills.label: Transitions
skills.description: Choose the transition word or phrase that best connects ideas between sentences or paragraphs (contrast, addition, cause/effect, sequence)

skills.label: Sentence boundaries
skills.description: Correct run-on sentences and fragments; use punctuation (period, semicolon, comma + conjunction) to join or separate clauses

skills.label: Subject-verb agreement
skills.description: Ensure verbs agree with their subjects in number; handle tricky cases (intervening phrases, inverted sentences, collective nouns)

skills.label: Pronoun-antecedent agreement
skills.description: Ensure pronouns agree with their antecedents in number and gender; avoid ambiguous pronoun reference

skills.label: Verb tense and form
skills.description: Choose the correct verb tense (past, present, future, perfect) and form (infinitive, gerund, participle) for the context

skills.label: Punctuation
skills.description: Use commas, colons, semicolons, dashes, and apostrophes correctly; punctuate nonrestrictive and restrictive clauses

skills.label: Modifiers
skills.description: Correct dangling and misplaced modifiers; ensure modifying phrases are adjacent to what they modify

skills.label: Noun number and possessives
skills.description: Distinguish singular vs. plural nouns; use apostrophes correctly for possessives; avoid confusion between its/it's, their/they're/there, and plural vs. possessive forms
